Call of Duty Mobile includes fan-favorite maps, modes, and operators from previous Call of Duty games.
Call of Duty Mobile is accessible on both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.
The speaker is currently experiencing a monotonous daily routine involving waking up, going to work, eating, and sleeping.
Call of Duty Mobile features new content exclusive to the mobile platform.
The speaker believes it is possible to break through the boredom associated with this routine this summer.

assumptions.text: The target audience finds their current routine dull and desires change.
Downloading and playing video games is an acceptable and effective way to alleviate boredom.
The inclusion of familiar elements from past Call of Duty titles increases appeal to fans.
Free access to Call of Duty Mobile will attract users who would otherwise pay for it.
Mobile-exclusive content adds sufficient novelty to justify downloading the app.
Users trust the credibility of the claim that the game is free 'today' without needing verification.
